reviewer.independence: No subject model was used as reviewer. The review read only the candidate fixture JSON files named below and did not inspect treatment outcomes or result artifacts.

criteria.human_coherence: Both complete histories read as coherent human-understandable records.
criteria.opposite_target_entailment: The fixed rule and variant-specific evidence logically entail the declared, opposite C and W focal targets.
criteria.minimal_pre_boundary_change: C and W differ only at the declared revised input and its dependent final pre-boundary record; no undeclared semantic input changes.
criteria.retained_tail_identity_and_neutrality: The retained tail is byte-identical between variants and contains no focal evidence or implication.
criteria.no_visible_focal_leakage: The focal targets, countertargets, and focal rule inputs are absent from the retained tail and any direct visible control fact.
criteria.no_invalidating_defect: Neither history contains a contradiction, garbage, or repetition severe enough to invalidate the record.
